name: 85757 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85757 (Tucson) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85757 (Tucson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85757 (Tucson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
